channel.title: Techmeme (readable links)
channel.description: Top news and commentary for technology's leaders, from all around the web

item.title: Google announces the expansion of ads in AI Mode into international markets, as growth in its core search advertising business slows (Lauren Forristal/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Lauren Forristal / TechCrunch:
Google announces the expansion of ads in AI Mode into international markets, as growth in its core search advertising business slows  —  Google is bringing ads in its AI-powered Search experiences to international markets, betting that generative AI can open up new revenue opportunities …

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/28/google-expands-ai-search-ads-globally-as-core-ad-growth-slows/

item.title: Samsung shares fall as much as 6.6% as a lack of a new shareholder return plan, higher capex, and its chip unit's profit miss weigh on investor sentiment (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Samsung shares fall as much as 6.6% as a lack of a new shareholder return plan, higher capex, and its chip unit's profit miss weigh on investor sentiment  —  Samsung Electronics Co. shares reversed earlier gains to slide as much as 6.6% as the lack of a new shareholder return plan in its earnings disappointed investors.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/samsung-electronics-shares-slide-after-return-plan-is-delayed

item.title: Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers  —  Samsung Electronics Co. plans to hike spending more than 60% this year after selling out of high-end chips for 2027 …

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/samsung-chip-profit-misses-estimates-lifted-by-resurgent-ai-hope

item.title: Google's search revenue rose 12% YoY to $63.25B in Q3 2026, down from 14.5% in Q3 2025, with Google attributing the slowdown to "lower monetization" in AI Mode (Simon Sharwood/The Register)
item.description:
Simon Sharwood / The Register:
Google's search revenue rose 12% YoY to $63.25B in Q3 2026, down from 14.5% in Q3 2025, with Google attributing the slowdown to “lower monetization” in AI Mode  —  That's a problem, cos it just spent $51 billion on infrastructure and still needs to rent compute from others to run its cloud

Original (direct link): https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/10/29/google-struggling-to-make-ai-mode-searches-pay/5306181

item.title: DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart (Ville Heiskanen/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Ville Heiskanen / Bloomberg:
DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart  —  DoorDash Inc., the food delivery provider in talks to take over Instacart, moved its earnings release date forward by almost a week.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/doordash-moves-earnings-date-forward-amid-instacart-deal-reports

item.title: Fragment, which uses AI to resolve purchasing and payment issues across manufacturing datasets, emerges from stealth with $56M from 8VC and others (Chris Metinko/Axios)
item.description:
Chris Metinko / Axios:
Fragment, which uses AI to resolve purchasing and payment issues across manufacturing datasets, emerges from stealth with $56M from 8VC and others  —  Procurement startup Fragment is exiting stealth with $56 million raised, CEO Pranav Mulgund tells Axios Pro exclusively.

Original (direct link): https://www.axios.com/pro/enterprise-software-deals/2026/10/28/fragment-procurement-software-botha

item.title: How surging demand from AI hyperscalers has quintupled flash memory prices and shifted market and negotiating power from Apple to suppliers like Kioxia (Rolfe Winkler/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Rolfe Winkler / Wall Street Journal:
How surging demand from AI hyperscalers has quintupled flash memory prices and shifted market and negotiating power from Apple to suppliers like Kioxia  —  The iPhone maker for years bullied flash-storage makers into steep discounts—until AI hyperscalers bid up prices and gobbled up supply

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/tech/apple-iphone-memory-chips-ai-c0084cc9?st=jB9Xwc&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
item.description:
Jenny Lee / CNBC:
Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates  —  - Samsung Electronics reported third-quarter earnings on Thursday, with operating profit broadly in line with analysts' estimates

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/samsung-electronics-third-quarter-earnings.html

item.title: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to selected cybersecurity defenders through Fairwind at $2/1M input and $10/1M output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 later (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
item.description:
Carl Franzen / VentureBeat:
Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to selected cybersecurity defenders through Fairwind at $2/1M input and $10/1M output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 later  —  Google announced its latest and most intelligent frontier AI model today: Gemini 4 Carbon promises improvements in cybersecurity …

Original (direct link): https://venturebeat.com/technology/google-unveils-gemini-4-carbon-retaking-the-worlds-no-1-spot-on-updated-harder-benchmarks-but-access-is-limited

item.title: The personal data of 41,000+ DHS employees and contractors, including CBP and ICE agents, leaks online after hackers claim they breached DHS' Okta login system (Wired)
item.description:
Wired:
The personal data of 41,000+ DHS employees and contractors, including CBP and ICE agents, leaks online after hackers claim they breached DHS' Okta login system  —  The leaked records include the locations of ICE and CBP facilities, workers' cell phone numbers, and the members of groups tied …

Original (direct link): https://www.wired.com/story/massive-leak-exposes-41000-homeland-security-workers-including-undercover-ice-agents/

item.title: Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22% (Tom Warren/The Verge)
item.description:
Tom Warren / The Verge:
Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22%  —  Windows and Xbox revenues have declined during Microsoft's first quarter of the 2027 financial year. … Microsoft just posted the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal financial results.

Original (direct link): https://www.theverge.com/tech/1020785/microsoft-earnings-revenue-q1-2027

item.title: Zillow agrees to pay $212.5M to settle an investor class action over its failed Zillow Offers home-flipping venture, after SCOTUS refused to hear its appeal (Jonathan Stempel/Reuters)
item.description:
Jonathan Stempel / Reuters:
Zillow agrees to pay $212.5M to settle an investor class action over its failed Zillow Offers home-flipping venture, after SCOTUS refused to hear its appeal  —  Zillow (ZG.O) said on Wednesday it will pay $212.5 million in cash to settle a class action accusing the online real estate marketplace …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/zillow-pay-2125-million-settle-class-action-over-failed-real-estate-venture-2026-10-28/

item.title: Sources: AI coding startup Cognition weighs a new funding round before year's end after receiving offers valuing it at $70B-$80B, up from $48B in September (Katie Roof/Business Insider)
item.description:
Katie Roof / Business Insider:
Sources: AI coding startup Cognition weighs a new funding round before year's end after receiving offers valuing it at $70B-$80B, up from $48B in September  —  Just weeks after announcing a new round of funding at a $48 billion valuation, AI coding startup Cognition is fielding new investor interest at a much higher price.

Original (direct link): https://www.businessinsider.com/cognition-round-of-funding-at-a-75-billion-valuation-2026-10

item.title: Seoul-based AI chip startup FuriosaAI raised a $620M Series D at a $2.9B valuation, up from $735M in 2025; South Korea's National Growth Fund contributed $280M (Yoolim Lee/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Yoolim Lee / Bloomberg:
Seoul-based AI chip startup FuriosaAI raised a $620M Series D at a $2.9B valuation, up from $735M in 2025; South Korea's National Growth Fund contributed $280M  —  South Korean AI chip startup FuriosaAI quadrupled its valuation to $2.9 billion in a fresh funding round, bolstering its bid to challenge the likes of Nvidia Corp.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-28/furiosaai-quadruples-valuation-to-2-9-billion-in-nvidia-chase

item.title: Sources: the US DOJ has inquired about the impact of Nvidia's Hugging Face deal on AI competition, as antitrust enforcers continue to probe Nvidia's conduct (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/world/us-doj-is-inquiring-about-nvidias-purchase-hugging-face-sources-say-2026-10-28/
